classification: DIAGNOSTIC (exploratory, read-only). Not performance evidence. Not a rescue of the closed 4v4 specialist-qualification line.
question: Do the qualified 4v4 specialists A3 and B2, played natively on Pole B, ever put more agents in their home region than a defense cap of 2 would allow, and if so how often and for how long? Answers whether a dynamic defense-cap allocator (cap = ceil(N/2)) would ever bind, before any such allocator is designed.
pole: B (OP7 + certified genome via pole_attestation.resolve_pole_genome, attested before any episode)

seeds.class: smoke (throwaway 999xxxxx family; checked free with seed_registry.py check)
seeds.shared: the same 16 seeds for A3 and B2

episode_path: Mirrors experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py run_cell for a plain (k = 0, non-role, non-split) policy: R2.build_env, install_keyed_opponent_overlays, set_phase/set_next_opponent SCRIPTED OP7, augment_obs_with_entities, assert_live_opponent_batch, min_alive_for_defender == 4 fail-closed, deterministic policy.predict, R2.MAX_STEPS horizon. No perturbation, no roles, no action change, no training.
decision_tick: every policy.predict call; the state is snapshotted read-only immediately before env.step (the state the policy acted on).

home_region.source: experiments/probe_learned_composition.py instrument() with experiments/run_learned_composition_probe.py R_POS = 4.5 ('frozen from the scripted cpu prototype; validated out of sample'); the same radius was used for the 4v4 scaffold trajectory export (R_HOME = 4.5). Adopted unchanged; not tuned.
home_region.center: the team's own flag HOME position (blue_flag_home)
home_region.home_count_primary: number of blue agents that are alive, untagged, not carrying, and within 4.5 cells of own flag home (instrument() defend-like count)
home_region.home_count_raw_secondary: number of alive blue agents within 4.5 cells of own flag home regardless of tagged/carrying status; reported for transparency, NOT used by the decision rule
home_region.no_exclusions: no opening ticks, spawn ticks or episodes are excluded

metrics_per_policy: pct_ticks_over_cap: ticks with home_count_primary > 2 divided by all decision ticks, pooled over the 16 episodes
pct_episodes_ever_over_cap: episodes with at least one tick home_count_primary > 2, out of 16
over_cap_periods: maximal runs of consecutive ticks with home_count_primary > 2; report count, mean length in ticks, median, max
pct_episodes_sustained_over_cap: episodes containing an over-cap period of at least 8 consecutive ticks (8 = H_r, the frozen role hold horizon)
the same over-cap numbers computed from home_count_raw_secondary (transparency only)

decision_rule.GO: for at least one of A3 or B2: pct_ticks_over_cap > 5% OR pct_episodes_sustained_over_cap >= 25% (>= 4 of 16 episodes)
decision_rule.NO_GO: otherwise: the cap essentially never binds for either policy on Pole B, so a dynamic defense-cap allocator would not change behaviour and is not built
decision_rule.meaning_of_GO: licenses DESIGNING (not running) a dynamic defense-cap follow-up under its own frozen spec and fresh seeds; it is not evidence that capping helps

not_reported_as_evidence: episode scores and wins are logged only for traceability and are excluded from the readout; 16 throwaway seeds carry no performance claim
outputs: artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/home_occupancy_4v4/ (per-tick rows CSV, RESULT JSON write-once, README)
